tk.urteil.fb_off_fluegel_innen: {a} ({ra}) can run the flank on the {seite} because {b} ({rb}) cuts inside. The wide lane belongs to the full-back.
tk.urteil.fb_off_fluegel_breit: {a} ({ra}) and {b} ({rb}) both want the {seite} touchline. One of them should cut inside or they get in each other's way.
tk.urteil.fb_def_fluegel_breit: {b} ({rb}) keeps the width on the {seite} while {a} ({ra}) covers behind. A stable flank.
tk.urteil.fb_inv_fluegel_breit: {a} ({ra}) steps inside while {b} ({rb}) stays wide: the width stays on the {seite} and the middle stays full.
tk.urteil.fb_inv_fluegel_innen: {a} ({ra}) and {b} ({rb}) both move inside. Nobody threatens down the flank on the {seite}.
tk.urteil.sechs_balance: {a} and {b} complement each other in front of the defence: one breaks up play, one distributes. A balanced double pivot.
tk.urteil.sechs_nur_aufbau: {a} and {b} both want to build play and nobody breaks it up. The centre is open to counters.
tk.urteil.sechs_nur_zerstoerer: {a} and {b} both break up play and nobody builds. The ball rarely reaches the front in order.
tk.urteil.sechs_pendler: {a} and {b}: one holds position, one shuttles. That carries the team over 90 minutes.
tk.urteil.zehner_spitze: {a} ({ra}) and {b} ({rb}) fit together: one supplies, the other finishes.
tk.urteil.zehner_falsche_neun: {b} ({rb}) pulls the defence out and {a} ({ra}) bursts into the gap.
tk.urteil.zwei_entgegen: {a} ({ra}) and {b} ({rb}) both come short. Then nobody runs in behind.
tk.urteil.keiner_in_die_tiefe: {a} ({ra}) drops deep but nobody runs in behind. The space stays unused.
tk.urteil.zu_offensiv: {n} players with attacking duties but only {m} covering. Losing the ball becomes dangerous.
tk.urteil.breite_fehlt: The side on the {seite} lacks width: nobody holds the flank there.
tk.urteil.gleiche_aufgabe: {a} and {b} have the same job ({aufgabe}). One of them should get a different role.
